E10-SCH: SELECT SUM(floor_area_m2) FROM warehouses WHERE warehouse_type = 'cold_chain'

M01-CAS: SELECT a.name, COUNT(ac.aircraft_id) AS plane_count FROM airlines a LEFT JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY plane_count DESC
M01-SCH: SELECT a.name, COUNT(ac.aircraft_id) AS aircraft_count FROM airlines a LEFT JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY aircraft_count DESC, a.name
M01-BIZ: SELECT a.name AS carrier_name, COUNT(ac.aircraft_id) AS fleet_size FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY fleet_size DESC
M01-VAG: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, COUNT(ac.aircraft_id) AS aircraft_count FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id GROUP BY a.name
M02-CAS: SELECT a.type_id, at.model, COUNT(*) AS active_planes FROM aircraft a JOIN aircraft_types at ON a.type_id = at.type_id WHERE a.status = 'active' GROUP BY a.type_id, at.model
M02-SCH: SELECT a.type_id, at.model, COUNT(a.aircraft_id) AS active_count FROM aircraft a JOIN aircraft_types at ON a.type_id = at.type_id WHERE a.status = 'active' GROUP BY a.type_id, at.model ORDER BY at.model
M02-BIZ: SELECT at.model, COUNT(a.aircraft_id) AS active_count FROM aircraft a JOIN aircraft_types at ON a.type_id = at.type_id WHERE a.status = 'active' GROUP BY at.model
M02-VAG: SELECT a.type_id, at.model, COUNT(*) AS active_planes FROM aircraft a JOIN aircraft_types at ON a.type_id = at.type_id WHERE a.status = 'active' GROUP BY a.type_id, at.model
M03-CAS: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights WHERE origin_airport_id = (SELECT airport_id FROM airports WHERE iata_code = 'IST') AND status = 'completed'
M03-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' AND origin_airport_id = (SELECT airport_id FROM airports WHERE iata_code = 'IST')
M03-BIZ: SELECT SUM(total_weight_kg) AS completed_departure_volume FROM shipments JOIN flight_cargo ON shipments.shipment_id = flight_cargo.shipment_id JOIN flights ON flight_cargo.flight_id = flights.flight_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' AND origin_airport_id = (SELECT airport_id FROM airports WHERE icao_code = 'IST')
M03-VAG: SELECT COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM flights WHERE origin_airport_id = (SELECT airport_id FROM airports WHERE iata_code = 'IST')
M04-CAS: SELECT origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-SCH: SELECT origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 5
M04-BIZ: SELECT T1.lane_number, COUNT(T2.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM lanes AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.lane_id = T2.lane_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.lane_number ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-VAG: SELECT origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM flights GROUP BY origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 10
M05-CAS: SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(f.actual_arrival, 12, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(f.actual_arrival, 15, 2) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(f.scheduled_arrival, 12, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 - CAST(SUBSTR(f.scheduled_arrival, 15, 2) AS INTEGER)) AS average_minutes_late FROM flights f WHERE f.status = 'completed'
M05-SCH: SELECT T1.name, AVG((strftime('%s', T2.actual_arrival) - strftime('%s', T2.scheduled_arrival)) / 60) AS avg_delay_minutes FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.aircraft_id = T2.aircraft_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.name ORDER BY avg_delay_minutes DESC
M05-BIZ: SELECT a.name AS carrier_name, AVG(CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(f.actual_arrival, 1, 2), ' ', '') AS INTEGER) - CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(f.scheduled_arrival, 1, 2), ' ', '') AS INTEGER)) AS avg_arrival_delay FROM airlines a JOIN flights f ON a.airline_id = f.airline_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' AND f.delay_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.name
M05-VAG: SELECT name FROM airlines ORDER BY founded_year DESC LIMIT 1
M06-CAS: SELECT a.name, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS cancelled_flights FROM airlines a JOIN flights f ON a.airline_id = f.airline_id WHERE f.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY a.name
M06-SCH: SELECT a.name, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS cancelled_flights FROM aircraft a JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY cancelled_flights DESC
M06-BIZ: SELECT a.name AS carrier_name, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS cancellation_volume FROM airlines a JOIN flights f ON a.airline_id = f.airline_id WHERE f.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY a.name
M06-VAG: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS cancellation_count FROM airlines a JOIN flights f ON a.airline_id = f.airline_id WHERE f.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY a.name
M07-CAS: SELECT a.name, SUM(f.co2_emissions_kg / 1000) AS total_co2_tonnes FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id JOIN flights f ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id GROUP BY a.name
M07-SCH: SELECT T4.name, ROUND(SUM(T1.co2_emissions_kg / 1000), 1) AS total_co2_emissions_kg FROM fuel_uplifts AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.flight_id = T2.flight_id JOIN aircraft AS T3 ON T2.aircraft_id = T3.aircraft_id JOIN airlines AS T4 ON T3.airline_id = T4.airline_id GROUP BY T4.name
M07-BIZ: SELECT a.name AS carrier_name, SUM(f.co2_emissions_kg) / 1000 AS carbon_footprint_tonnes FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id JOIN flights f ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id GROUP BY a.name
M07-VAG: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, SUM(f.co2_emissions_kg) AS total_emissions_kg FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id JOIN flights f ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY total_emissions_kg DESC
M08-CAS: SELECT AVG(price_usd_per_litre) AS avg_fuel_price_per_litre, region FROM fuel_uplifts JOIN airports ON fuel_uplifts.airport_id = airports.airport_id GROUP BY region
M08-SCH: SELECT AVG(price_usd_per_litre) AS avg_price_per_litre, region FROM fuel_uplifts JOIN airports ON fuel_uplifts.airport_id = airports.airport_id GROUP BY region ROUND(avg_price_per_litre, 4)
M08-BIZ: SELECT AVG(price_usd_per_litre) AS avg_fuel_price_per_litre, region FROM fuel_uplifts JOIN airports ON fuel_uplifts.airport_id = airports.airport_id GROUP BY region
M08-VAG: SELECT airports.name, AVG(fuel_uplifts.price_usd_per_litre) AS avg_fuel_price_per_litre FROM airports JOIN fuel_uplifts ON airports.airport_id = fuel_uplifts.airport_id GROUP BY airports.name ORDER BY avg_fuel_price_per_litre DESC LIMIT 1
M09-CAS: SELECT a.airport_id, a.name, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id GROUP BY a.airport_id, a.name HAVING COUNT(w.warehouse_id) >= 4
M09-SCH: SELECT a.iata_code, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id GROUP BY a.iata_code HAVING warehouse_count >= 4
M09-BIZ: SELECT T1.name FROM airports AS T1 JOIN warehouses AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.airport_id GROUP BY T1.name HAVING COUNT(T2.warehouse_id) >= 4
M09-VAG: SELECT a.airport_id, a.name, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id GROUP BY a.airport_id, a.name ORDER BY warehouse_count DESC LIMIT 10
M10-CAS: SELECT a.name, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS bonded_warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id WHERE w.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY a.name HAVING bonded_warehouse_count > 1
M10-SCH: SELECT a.iata_code, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS bonded_warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id WHERE w.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY a.iata_code HAVING bonded_warehouse_count > 1
M10-BIZ: SELECT T1.name, COUNT(T2.warehouse_id) AS bonded_count FROM airports AS T1 JOIN warehouses AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.airport_id WHERE T2.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY T1.name HAVING bonded_count > 1
M10-VAG: SELECT a.airport_id, a.name, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS bonded_warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id WHERE w.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY a.airport_id, a.name HAVING COUNT(w.warehouse_id) > 1
H01-CAS: SELECT a.name, ac.tail_number, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_flights FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id JOIN flights f ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.name, ac.tail_number ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 1
H01-SCH: SELECT a.name, MIN(ac.tail_number) AS tail_number, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id JOIN flights f ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY flight_count DESC, tail_number ASC LIMIT 1
H01-BIZ: SELECT a1.name AS airline_name, a2.model AS aircraft_model, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_flights FROM airlines a1 JOIN aircraft a2 ON a1.airline_id = a2.airline_id JOIN flights f ON a2.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id AND f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a1.name, a2.model ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 1
H01-VAG: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, at.model AS aircraft_model, COUNT(fc.flight_cargo_id) AS flight_count FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id JOIN aircraft_types at ON ac.type_id = at.type_id JOIN flight_cargo fc ON ac.aircraft_id = fc.aircraft_id GROUP BY a.name, at.model ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H02-CAS: SELECT a1.name AS airport_name, a2.name AS airline_name, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS landing_count FROM airports a1 JOIN flights f ON a1.airport_id = f.destination_airport_id JOIN airlines a2 ON f.airline_id = a2.airline_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a1.name, a2.name ORDER BY a1.name, landing_count DESC
H02-SCH: SELECT T1.iata_code, T1.name, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM airports AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.destination_airport_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.iata_code, T1.name ORDER BY flight_count DESC, T1.name LIMIT 1
H02-BIZ: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, ap.name AS airport_name, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_arrivals FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id JOIN flights f ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id JOIN airports ap ON f.destination_airport_id = ap.airport_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.name, ap.name ORDER BY completed_arrivals DESC
H02-VAG: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, ap.name AS airport_name, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id JOIN flights f ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id JOIN airports ap ON f.origin_airport_id = ap.airport_id GROUP BY a.name, ap.name ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H03-CAS: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', issued_date) AS month, SUM(amount_usd) AS monthly_invoice, SUM(SUM(amount_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY issued_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM invoices WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', issued_date) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H03-SCH: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', issued_date) AS month, SUM(amount_usd) AS total_amount, SUM(SUM(amount_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY issued_date) AS running_total FROM invoices WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', issued_date) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H03-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', issued_date) AS month, SUM(amount_usd) AS billed_revenue, SUM(SUM(amount_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', issued_date)) AS ytd_cumulative_revenue FROM invoices WHERE strftime('%Y', issued_date) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H03-VAG: SELECT SUM(freight_charge_usd + fuel_surcharge_usd + security_fee_usd + handling_fee_usd + dg_surcharge_usd - discount_usd) AS total_revenue FROM invoices WHERE issued_date BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(issued_date) FROM invoices) AND (SELECT MAX(issued_date) FROM invoices)
H04-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', f.scheduled_departure) AS month, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS flights_completed, LAG(COUNT(f.flight_id)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.scheduled_departure)) - COUNT(f.flight_id) AS change_from_previous_month FROM flights f WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.scheduled_departure) ORDER BY month
H04-SCH: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', actual_departure) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights, LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', actual_departure)) - COUNT(*) AS difference_to_previous_month FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', actual_departure) ORDER BY month
H04-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', f.scheduled_departure) AS month, SUM(fc.total_weight_kg) AS total_volume_kg, LAG(SUM(fc.total_weight_kg)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.scheduled_departure)) AS previous_month_volume_kg, (SUM(fc.total_weight_kg) - LAG(SUM(fc.total_weight_kg)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.scheduled_departure))) / LAG(SUM(fc.total_weight_kg)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.scheduled_departure)) AS month_over_month_change FROM flights f JOIN flight_cargo fc ON f.flight_id = fc.flight_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H04-VAG: SELECT SUBSTR(scheduled_departure, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM flights GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H05-CAS: SELECT a.tail_number, AVG(julianday(f2.actual_arrival) - julianday(f1.actual_arrival)) AS avg_ground_time FROM aircraft a JOIN flights f1 ON a.aircraft_id = f1.aircraft_id AND f1.status = 'completed' JOIN flights f2 ON a.aircraft_id = f2.aircraft_id AND f2.status = 'completed' AND f2.flight_id > f1.flight_id GROUP BY a.tail_number ORDER BY avg_ground_time ASC LIMIT 5
H05-SCH: SELECT a.tail_number, AVG(julianday(f.actual_departure) - julianday(t.event_time)) AS avg_time_diff FROM aircraft a JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id JOIN tracking_events t ON f.flight_id = t.flight_id AND t.event_code = 'DEP' WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.tail_number ORDER BY avg_time_diff ASC LIMIT 5
H05-BIZ: SELECT a.tail_number, AVG(julianday(f2.actual_arrival) - julianday(f1.actual_arrival)) AS avg_turnaround FROM aircraft a JOIN flights f1 ON a.aircraft_id = f1.aircraft_id AND f1.status = 'completed' JOIN flights f2 ON a.aircraft_id = f2.aircraft_id AND f2.status = 'completed' AND f2.flight_id > f1.flight_id GROUP BY a.tail_number ORDER BY avg_turnaround ASC LIMIT 5
H05-VAG: SELECT AVG(julianday(flights.actual_arrival) - julianday(flights.scheduled_departure)) AS avg_turnaround_time FROM flights WHERE flights.status = 'completed'
H06-CAS: SELECT c.name, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS total_invoiced, (SUM(i.amount_usd) / (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices)) * 100 AS share FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING total_invoiced > (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) * 0.04 FROM invoices)
H06-SCH: SELECT c.name, SUM(i.amount_usd) / ( SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices ) AS percentage FROM customers c JOIN shipments s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id JOIN invoices i ON s.shipment_id = i.shipment_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING percentage > 0.04
H06-BIZ: SELECT c.account_code, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, (SUM(i.amount_usd) / (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices)) * 100 AS share FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.account_code HAVING revenue > (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) * 0.04 FROM invoices)
H06-VAG: SELECT c.name, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
H07-CAS: SELECT a.airport_id, a.name, SUM(s.chargeable_weight_kg) AS total_cargo_tonnes FROM airports a JOIN flights f ON a.airport_id = f.origin_airport_id JOIN flight_cargo fc ON f.flight_id = fc.flight_id JOIN shipments s ON fc.shipment_id = s.shipment_id GROUP BY a.airport_id, a.name ORDER BY total_cargo_tonnes DESC LIMIT 5
H07-SCH: SELECT origin_airport_id, SUM(total_weight_kg / 1000) AS total_tonnes, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_weight_kg / 1000) DESC) AS rank FROM flight_cargo WHERE leg_status = 'flown' GROUP BY origin_airport_id ORDER BY rank LIMIT 5
H07-BIZ: SELECT a.name AS airport_name, SUM(s.chargeable_weight_kg) AS outbound_tonnage FROM airports a JOIN flights f ON a.airport_id = f.origin_airport_id JOIN shipments s ON f.flight_id = s.flight_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY outbound_tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-VAG: SELECT a.name, COUNT(c.declaration_id) AS export_count FROM airports a JOIN customs_declarations c ON a.airport_id = c.warehouse_id WHERE c.declaration_type = 'export' GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY export_count DESC LIMIT 10
H08-CAS: SELECT a.model, COUNT(fc.flight_cargo_id) AS completed_flights_more_than_half_full FROM aircraft a JOIN aircraft_types at ON a.type_id = at.type_id JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id JOIN flight_cargo fc ON f.flight_id = fc.flight_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' AND fc.load_sequence = 1 AND fc.total_volume_m3 * 1000 > at.max_volume_m3 * 0.5 GROUP BY a.model
H08-SCH: SELECT a.model, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_flights FROM aircraft AS a JOIN aircraft_types AS at ON a.type_id = at.type_id JOIN flight_cargo AS fc ON a.aircraft_id = fc.aircraft_id JOIN flights AS f ON fc.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.model HAVING SUM(fc.total_volume_m3) > 0.5 * at.max_volume_m3
H08-BIZ: SELECT at.model, COUNT(fc.flight_id) AS completed_flights FROM aircraft_types at JOIN aircraft a ON at.type_id = a.type_id JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id JOIN flight_cargo fc ON f.flight_id = fc.flight_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY at.model HAVING SUM(fc.total_volume_m3) * 100 / SUM(fc.chargeable_weight_kg) > 50
H08-VAG: SELECT T1.model FROM aircraft_types AS T1 JOIN aircraft AS T2 ON T1.type_id = T2.type_id WHERE T2.total_flight_hours BETWEEN T1.max_payload_kg / 2 AND T1.max_payload_kg
H09-CAS: SELECT a.tail_number FROM aircraft a JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id JOIN airports ap ON f.destination_airport_id = ap.airport_id WHERE ap.is_cargo_hub = 1 GROUP BY a.tail_number HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.airport_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1)
H09-SCH: SELECT T1.tail_number FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.aircraft_id = T2.aircraft_id JOIN airports AS T3 ON T2.destination_airport_id = T3.airport_id WHERE T3.is_cargo_hub = 1 GROUP BY T1.tail_number HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T3.airport_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1)
H09-BIZ: SELECT DISTINCT a.tail_number FROM aircraft a JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'completed'
H09-VAG: SELECT DISTINCT T1.model FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.aircraft_id = T2.aircraft_id ORDER BY T1.model
H10-CAS: SELECT customs_country, COUNT(*) AS frequency FROM customs_declarations WHERE (duty_rate_pct + vat_amount_usd / customs_value_usd * 100) > 20 GROUP BY customs_country
H10-SCH: SELECT customs_country, COUNT(*) AS import_rows FROM customs_declarations WHERE declaration_type = 'import' AND (duty_amount_usd + vat_amount_usd) > 0.2 * customs_value_usd GROUP BY customs_country
H10-BIZ: SELECT customs_country, COUNT(*) FROM customs_declarations WHERE duty_rate_pct > 20 GROUP BY customs_country
H10-VAG: SELECT customs_country FROM customs_declarations WHERE duty_rate_pct > 10 ORDER BY duty_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 1
